hosting.admin.storage_unenforced: The wikis on this server have no hard storage quotas (BW_HOSTING_TENANT_QUOTAS={setting}): the wiki storage does not enforce them, or the server's services cannot use them yet (“sudo bananawiki status” on the server says which). Each wiki's storage limit is still checked, by the upload checks and by the storage check that runs every 5 minutes, which suspends a wiki above 110% of its limit, so between two checks a wiki can go over its limit and, at worst, fill the disk. For hard limits, put the wiki storage on an XFS filesystem mounted with prjquota (UPGRADING.md, “Wiki storage and hard quotas”): they are then used automatically.
hosting.admin.storage_lost: Hard per-wiki storage quotas were enforced on this server before and are no longer available: the wikis now run without them (BW_HOSTING_TENANT_QUOTAS={setting}). Each wiki's storage limit is now checked only by the upload checks and the storage check that runs every 5 minutes, so one wiki can fill the disk between two checks. If this was not intended, run “sudo bananawiki status” on the server: it says what changed. Restore the wiki storage's XFS prjquota mount (remounted without prjquota, or replaced) or, if the services run under units an older controller wrote, run “sudo bananawiki restart”. Within 5 minutes the wikis are then put under quota again.
hosting.admin.storage_refused: Wikis cannot start: this server requires hard per-wiki storage quotas (BW_HOSTING_TENANT_QUOTAS={setting}), but the wiki storage does not enforce them. Run “sudo bananawiki status” on the server to see what to do.
hosting.admin.storage_off: Hard per-wiki storage quotas are switched off on this server (BW_HOSTING_TENANT_QUOTAS=off). Each wiki's storage limit is checked only by the upload checks and the storage check that runs every 5 minutes, which suspends a wiki above 110% of its limit, so between two checks a wiki can go over its limit and, at worst, fill the disk. To turn them on, run “sudo bananawiki config set tenant-quotas auto” on the server (they are used where the wiki storage is XFS mounted with prjquota).
